messages:
kevin: quick heads-up — planning a staggered rollout for the new console UI exposure flags (hidden settings + limited access). targeting a small canary first, want quick sanity checks.
maria: can you summarize audience + guardrails?
kevin: sure. plan = 3-stage rollout:
  1) 5% orgs (tag: early_access=true) for 24h
  2) 25% orgs for 48h with metrics check
  3) global on if no regressions
  guardrails: auto-abort if error_rate > 1.5% or median load_time increase > 20% vs baseline, and manual stop if negative NPS in feedback form.
sara: how are we gating by org? do we have a server-side feature gate or only client-side flag?
kevin: server-side gate + client visibility toggle. backend will short-circuit responses if flag=off. also shipping an admin opt-out in org settings.
jon: please add a migration script to mark current beta orgs as early_access=true so they don't lose access.
maria: telemetry bits we need:
  - feature_flag: console.ui.hidden_settings=true/false
  - rollout_stage: canary/partial/global
  - rollout_id: rdw-ui-2026-03
  - debug_tag: enable_prefix_cache
  include those in all requests from console components.
kevin: adding the telemetry plan to the PR. will include event names for rollout_start/rollout_abort/feedback_received.
sara: small ask — include a per-org opt-out header so proxies can filter quickly: X-Redwood-Org-Flag: early_access=true
kevin: yep, will add header and API validation.
eng-platform-bot: quota-check: dedicated pool available (g4dn-equivalent) — projected CPU/GPU headroom OK for 5% canary, ensure autoscale policy is on.
kevin: tagging @eng-platform — please verify autoscale policy respects canary burst.
eng-platform-bot: acknowledged. autoscale policy reviewed, canary burst=enabled, fallback region set to us-west-2.
jon: code review ping: PR #4128 has the flag wiring + sanity tests. reviewers: @maria, @sara.
maria: taking a look now. quick note: server flag name should be console.ui.expose_hidden_settings (dot namespace).
kevin: will rename accordingly. thanks.
jon: test plan snippet (will include in PR):
```
- create org with early_access=true
- hit /console/features -> expect hidden_settings:true in response body
- simulate high error-rate by returning 5xx -> expect rollout abort status set in rollout log
- verify admin opt-out flips flag immediately
```
maria: looks good. also add an integration smoke that toggles via admin UI to catch frontend regens.
sara: any comms for customers? we should email early access orgs + add a console banner for first-time users in canary.
kevin: yes — comms draft ready, will share in #marketing-review. banner text short: "You're in the new Console preview — give feedback via this form." :memo:
jon: deploy-bot scheduled canary job: id rdw-rollout-1782, window 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z -> 2026-03-19T16:00:00Z.
deploy-bot: canary created rdw-rollout-1782, target groups: tag=early_access, percent=5
kevin: final checklist: PR merged, infra autoscale verified, telemetry events wired, comms copied to marketing, admin opt-out implemented. callout: abort criteria logged and alerting wired to #incidents.
maria: I approved PR and left a minor naming nit.
sara: will run the smoke suite right before start.
kevin: thanks all — launching the canary tomorrow 16:00 UTC unless any objections. :thumbsup:
jon: no objections from security/custops, I pinged them earlier.
kevin: perfect. recording decision and rollout id in the console rollout tracker.
